paragraphs.text: God chose that place among the hills to establish Jerusalem and his temple.
paragraphs.label: a
paragraphs.anchor: foundation is in the holy mountains

paragraphs.text: Though your glorious estate does not yet appear, wait with patience and God will accomplish his promise.
paragraphs.label: b
paragraphs.anchor: Glorious things are spoken of thee

paragraphs.text: That is, Egypt and these other countries will come to the knowledge of God.

paragraphs.text: It will be said of him who is regenerate and come to the Church, that he is as one who was born in the Church.
paragraphs.label: d

paragraphs.text: Out of all quarters they will come to the Church, and be counted as citizens.
paragraphs.label: e
paragraphs.anchor: This and that man was born

paragraphs.text: When he calls them by his word into the Church, whom he had elected and written in the book.
paragraphs.label: f

paragraphs.text: The prophet sets his whole affections and comfort in the church.
